title: INTRODUCTION TO HORTICULTURAL SYSTEMS, PRACTICES AND CAREERS
description: Overview of horticultural systems and practices, with an emphasis on the Pacific Northwest. Exploration of career opportunities in horticulture. Includes viticulture, environmental landscaping, turf management, greenhouse and nursery production, farming, education, and research. Required field trips.
meeting_html: F 1pm-3:50pm in ALS 4000 - Agricultural & Life Sciences B 4000 (9/23 to 12/4)
